$comment: Generated by conformance/generate.py. Verify each fixture against the trusted keys in jwks.json; every verifier must report exactly this code (null means the signature verifies).

signatures/signed.flexova.description: Signed with the trusted key (alg Ed25519, RFC 9864).

signatures/signed-legacy-alg.flexova.description: Signed with alg EdDSA (RFC 8037), which verifiers still accept.

signatures/signed-optional-header.flexov.description: The optional typ and iat header parameters, plus an unknown one, are allowed.

signatures/unsigned.flexova.description: A valid package without a signature file.

signatures/tampered-entry.flexova.description: A chapter changed after signing, so it no longer matches its manifest hash.

signatures/tampered-manifest.flexova.description: A design token changed in the manifest after signing; the package is still valid.

signatures/wrong-key.flexova.description: Signed with a different private key under the trusted key's ID.

signatures/unknown-kid.flexova.description: The key ID is not in the trusted key set.

signatures/kid-wrong-curve.flexova.description: The key ID names a trusted Ed448 key, which is not usable.

signatures/kid-wrong-use.flexova.description: The key ID names a trusted Ed25519 key marked for encryption (use: enc).

signatures/alg-none.flexova.description: An unsecured JWS (alg none) with an empty signature.

signatures/alg-hs256.flexova.description: An HMAC algorithm, as in key-confusion attacks.

signatures/embedded-jwk.flexova.description: The header carries its own key (jwk), which verifiers must never trust.

signatures/crit-header.flexova.description: An unencoded payload (b64: false) declared critical.

signatures/missing-kid.flexova.description: The protected header has no key ID.

signatures/kid-not-string.flexova.description: The key ID is a number.

signatures/iat-not-integer.flexova.description: The signing time is a string.

signatures/header-not-object.flexova.description: The protected header is a JSON array.

signatures/attached-payload.flexova.description: The payload is attached instead of detached.

signatures/not-jws.flexova.description: The signature file is not a JWS.

signatures/padded-base64.flexova.description: The signature segment uses base64 padding, which base64url in JWS forbids.

signatures/oversized.flexova.description: The signature file exceeds the 4,096-byte limit.

signatures/signature-not-reduced.flexova.description: A malleated signature whose S value is not reduced modulo L (RFC 8032).
